audit_receipt.quantile_method: linear; 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles, at least 90% draws estimable
audit_receipt.interpretation: Conditional site/circular-block sampling sensitivity on fixed sequence marker topologies. Intervals are not calibrated for topology/model/prediction error or all spatial feature dependence. Paired sampling covariance describes estimation error, not evolutionary coupling. No branch ratios, p-values or acceleration rankings.

controller_receipt.scope: Conditional paired site/block branch sampling sensitivity on fixed AA topologies. Not total calibrated uncertainty, independent biological coupling, selection or acceleration evidence.

independent_table_checks.scope: All artifact hashes, audit source hashes and controller binding; exact marker/block grid, count agreement, unique branch/fit keys, paired covariance equality and Cauchy bounds, finite ordered percentiles and valid ranges. Percentiles not independently recomputed in this checkpoint. Full native artifact and resampled-alignment validation is provided by the completed auditor.
